data.name: The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves
data.detailed_description:
IMPORTANT, READ CAREFULLY!

About the genre of this game

This game is visual novel. You cannot directly control the 3D model of the protagonist, you will advance the game plot using textual links. You can read more about the visual novels using the link below:

DESCRIPTION

The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves is an adventure visual novel about the heroic feats of the intrepid warrior Ragnar.

Now you can become the famed adventurer Ragnar and bravely seek out all-new original adventures in this exciting game.

Delve into the mysteries of the caves and discover what lies in waiting below. Ready your sword: you will investigate sprawling, far-reaching webs of intrigues and unmask the cunning evildoer who stands in your way.

Can you tell a friend from a foe; who wants to manipulate you and who really needs your help?

Ragnar has six qualities you can choose from; each one influences the plot in its own way. But you must strategize well because you may only choose three.

Conquer all those who oppose you, overcome difficulties, let your conscience guide you through tough choices, and don't let lies ensnare you in a sticky web.

Take control over your hero's destiny to unlock the multiple endings and get the richest rewards.

Discover the truth in the darkest depths of the subterranean caves…

MAIN FEATURES

  • Non-linear, choose-your-own-adventure plot
  • Unique endings to find
  • More than 300 detailed illustrations
  • Mosaic plot that completely opens by only completing a few storylines
  • Cross-platform compatibility (Windows, Mac, Linux)
  • Steam trading cards and badges
  • Achievements
  • Steam Cloud support

content_descriptors.notes:
We must make things clear, in order to avoid misunderstanding of 18+ content rating of our game.
This label does not mean that this is a game with adult content. In fact, there is no adult content at all.
According to the laws, games containing scenes of smoking, drinking of alchoholic beverages, usage of mild drugs are prohibited for the children. Our heroes drink wine, smoke hookah (presumably with mild drugs :) ).

Also our game contains quite a bit of erotic scenes, scenes of violence and gambling.
We were arguing in our team about the content rating of the game and decided to set the maximum possible just to avoid possible problems.

So, please have in mind: this game is NOT about tits and asses (well, not only about it :) ). This is the game about adventures, with spirit of old movies and books about barbarians, which we love. We tried to create something similar and hopefully we did it :)

reviews.review:
The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves is a fantasy visual novel that successfully captures the spirit of classic sword-and-sorcery adventures while delivering a surprisingly deep interactive narrative. Developed and published by NLB project, the game places players in the role of Ragnar, a hardened barbarian whose journey into a mysterious underground world becomes far more complicated than a simple treasure hunt. Rather than relying on action-heavy gameplay, the experience focuses on storytelling, decision-making, and character development, creating an adventure that feels closer to a tabletop role-playing campaign than a traditional video game.

One of the game's most notable strengths is the way it handles player choice. Ragnar can be shaped through a selection of character traits that influence dialogue options, available actions, and the overall direction of the story. Since only a portion of the available qualities can be chosen during a single playthrough, players are encouraged to approach situations differently in future runs. This design gives choices genuine weight and prevents the adventure from feeling overly linear. Certain obstacles can be overcome through strength and intimidation, while others reward intelligence, diplomacy, or careful planning.

The narrative gradually expands beyond its initial premise, introducing a network of secrets, rival factions, and personal agendas hidden beneath the surface. The subterranean setting is filled with unusual characters, dangerous encounters, and moral decisions that challenge players to consider the consequences of their actions. Trust is often difficult to establish, and many situations offer multiple perspectives rather than clear-cut solutions. This layered storytelling helps maintain engagement throughout the adventure and makes the world feel more alive than many visual novels with similar budgets.

Presentation is another area where the game performs well. The large collection of illustrations adds significant visual appeal and helps bring important scenes to life. Character portraits, environmental artwork, and event illustrations provide context for the story while reinforcing the game's fantasy atmosphere. The art style may not have the production values of major commercial visual novels, but it effectively supports the narrative and demonstrates a considerable amount of effort from the developers.

Replayability is a major focus of the experience. The branching structure contains numerous routes, outcomes, and endings, many of which reveal new information about the overarching plot. Completing one path often raises additional questions that can only be answered through subsequent playthroughs. This approach transforms the game into a larger narrative puzzle where players gradually uncover hidden truths by exploring alternative decisions and character builds. The result is an adventure that rewards curiosity and experimentation rather than simply offering a single straightforward storyline.

The mature themes included throughout the game are present to support the setting and narrative rather than dominate the experience. Violence, adult situations, gambling, and other mature elements contribute to the rough and dangerous atmosphere of Ragnar's world. While these aspects are noticeable, they never completely overshadow the central focus on exploration, storytelling, and character interaction. Players interested primarily in fantasy narratives will likely find that the adventure remains accessible despite its mature content designation.

The game's biggest limitation is that it is firmly rooted in the visual novel genre. Those expecting action combat, extensive exploration mechanics, or traditional RPG progression may find the experience too text-heavy. Much of the enjoyment comes from reading, making decisions, and discovering new story branches. Players who appreciate interactive fiction will likely find this rewarding, while those seeking constant gameplay variety may struggle with the slower pace.

Overall, The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves is an engaging and thoughtfully designed fantasy visual novel that offers meaningful choices, strong world-building, and substantial replay value. Its combination of branching narratives, character customization, and mystery-driven storytelling creates an experience that remains compelling across multiple playthroughs. Although it caters primarily to fans of interactive fiction, it succeeds in delivering an entertaining adventure filled with memorable characters, intriguing secrets, and the classic charm of old-school fantasy storytelling.

Rating: 7/10
